name: Nodus
description: One focused workspace for channels, direct messages, announcements and your team.

metadata.title: Nodus — one workspace for team communication
metadata.description: Channels, direct messages, announcements and your whole team in one focused workspace.

hero.title: A clearer way to work together.
hero.description: Bring channels, direct messages, announcements and your team into one focused workspace.
hero.visualAlt: The #general channel in Nodus: a team discussion next to the channel list with unread counters and the list of online members.

introduction.title: One shared workspace for the way your team talks.
introduction.description: Instead of scattered chats, every team gets a workspace with a clear place for discussion, private conversations and official updates.

workspaces.title: Workspaces and channels
workspaces.description: Give each team its own space and each topic its own channel.

conversations.title: Direct messages
conversations.description: Talk one-to-one in real time, with presence and read receipts.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Publish important updates right away or schedule them for later.

overview.title: Everything in one workspace.
overview.description: The overview shows the whole workspace at a glance: who is on the team, where new messages are waiting and what was announced recently.

points.metrics: Totals for members, channels, messages and announcements
points.channels: Every channel with its unread count
points.announcements: The latest announcements, one click away

overview.visualAlt: The Nodus workspace overview with member, channel and message totals, the channel list with unread counts and recent announcements.

conversations.title: Conversations that stay focused.
conversations.description: Take a discussion one-to-one without leaving the workspace.

realtime.description: Messages appear the moment they are sent.

receipts.description: Check marks show when your message has been read.

presence.description: See whether a teammate is online before you write.

history.description: Every conversation keeps its full message history.

conversations.visualAlt: A direct conversation between Alex Morgan and Maya Chen with read receipts and an online status.

channels.title: Organize work around what matters.
channels.description: Topic-based channels keep group discussions apart, so product, engineering and design each have a place of their own.

topics.title: A channel for every topic
topics.description: Create channels for projects, teams or any subject that needs its own thread.

navigation.title: Clear navigation
navigation.description: Unread counters show exactly where new messages are waiting.

appearance.title: Light and dark
appearance.description: Switch between the light and dark theme whenever you like.

channels.visualAlt: The #general channel in the light theme with the channel sidebar and the members panel.

team.title: Know who’s on your team.
team.description: See every member of the workspace, their role and whether they are online. Invite new people and manage access as the team grows.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Owner, admin and member roles define who manages the workspace.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.description: Create invitation links and see when they were used or expire.

presence.title: Presence
presence.description: Online and offline status for every member, updated live.

access.title: Access
access.description: Change a member’s role or remove them when needed.

team.visualAlt: The Nodus members page with a table of members, their status and roles, and a list of invitations.

announcements.title: Important updates deserve their own space.
announcements.description: Announcements keep official news apart from everyday chat. Publish an update right away or schedule it for the right moment.
announcements.visualAlt: The Nodus announcements page with published announcements and a tab for scheduled ones.

notifications.title: Stay in the loop, without the noise.
notifications.description: In-app notifications collect new direct messages, announcements and role changes in one panel, with unread states that update in real time.
notifications.visualAlt: The Nodus notifications panel with unread notifications about a new announcement and new direct messages.

invitation.title: Bring your team together.
invitation.description: Create your workspace and start collaborating with Nodus.
